Subject: Re: Freelance Project Contract Questions

Hi Eliana,

Thank you for reviewing the contract and for your feedback. I appreciate you bringing these points to my attention.

Regarding the payment terms, I understand your preference for a net-30 structure. While our standard policy is net-60, I am open to discussing this further to see if we can reach a middle ground that works for both parties.

As for the non-compete clause, I agree that it is important for the terms to be equitable. Let’s schedule a brief call to discuss potential adjustments that would make the clause more reasonable while still protecting our business interests.

Please let me know what days and times work best for you to connect.

Best regards,

Ms. Adams
